said.own_reader:
How I read it:
- "A bike costs $200.": dollar base = 200 dollars
- "It is on sale for 25% off.": rate = 0.25
- change = dollar base × rate = 200 × 0.25 = 50 dollars
- new amount = dollar base - change = 200 - 50 = 150 dollars
So the answer is 150 dollars.
